detailed_descriptions.en: Throne and Liberty - Character Boost Answer the call of Solisium. The Character Boost allows you to create a brand-new character with a head start on progression. When creating your character, select the option to apply the Character Boost and receive a host of perks, including gear, progression, and more, so you can jump straight into the action alongside your friends.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Throne and Liberty - Character Boost

Answer the call of Solisium. The Character Boost allows you to create a brand-new character with a head start on progression. When creating your character, select the option to apply the Character Boost and receive a host of perks, including gear, progression, and more, so you can jump straight into the action alongside your friends.
